title: What If You Woke Up Unable to Smell Anything?

scenes.text: What if you woke up and couldn't smell anything? Food is the least of your problems.
Smell makes up most of what you call taste, so your favorite meals turn flat. Some people stop wanting to eat at all.
Then the safety side shows up. You can't smell smoke, spoiled milk, or a gas leak.
Smell loss affects somewhere between three and twenty percent of people, and most never expect it.
Reviews of the research keep finding high rates of depression and social withdrawal.
Smell is wired straight into your memory and emotions. Lose it, and you lose a hidden layer of your life.
